title: 1975. Maximum Matrix Sum

examples.explanation: We can follow the following steps to reach sum equals 4: - Multiply the 2 elements in the first row by -1. - Multiply the 2 elements in the first column by -1.
We can follow the following step to reach sum equals 16: - Multiply the 2 last elements in the second row by -1.
